coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, and .gitignore due to LLM API errors (HTTP 400 BadRequestError).
learnings: The audit tool should implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms when encountering transient API errors (like HTTP 400) on critical files such as PKGBUILD, rather than immediately failing the audit or marking the package inconclusive.
